title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: determining an enrollment's first billing cycle
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, whether a billing-cycle charge is an enrollment's first is determined by counting how many dues charges already exist in that enrollment's billing history. Where none exist yet, the charge being billed is the enrollment's first cycle; where one or more dues charges already exist in that history, the charge being billed is not the first cycle.

This determination decides whether a one-time first-cycle charge applies in addition to the recurring rate for that billing cycle; the basis for that charge is stated in a separate document.
